description_zh: 在匝道让行时，后车追尾前方静止车辆，选择后车为 ego 测试其能否及时停车。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV entered the slip lane which connects westbound 13th Street to northbound Mission Street and came to a stop to yield to cross-traffic on Mission Street.
As the Waymo AV was stopped, the front of the passenger car which was traveling behind the Waymo AV made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 后车移动且追尾静止前车，选择后车为 ego 测试其驾驶决策。
